output.subject: Your message about ATM fees on your recent trip
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us about the ATM fees from your recent trip. You told us that each of the five times you used an ATM while away, you were charged $3.50 by Meridian Harbor and another $3.50 by the other bank. You mentioned that you know we don't have ATMs where you were travelling and that the fees are covered in the disclosure, but that paying both charges every time still feels like a racket. We appreciate you being so direct with us, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

You also suggested that Meridian Harbor join one of the no-fee ATM networks. That is helpful feedback, and we have shared your message, including that suggestion, with our Deposit Operations team for review.

We will respond to you within 10 business days. If there is anything else you would like us to consider in the meantime, simply reply to this email.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer did not ask for a refund; decide whether to offer any goodwill gesture on the five Meridian $3.50 fees (total $17.50), or none.
Confirm the five out-of-network ATM fees on the account and that they match the disclosed fee.
Note that the third-party $3.50 surcharges are set by the other bank; decide how to explain this in the final reply.
Decide how to respond to the request to join a no-fee ATM network and whether any existing options for travellers should be mentioned.
Customer references ⟦NAME_1⟧ (likely a branch/ATM name or location); check what it refers to before replying with specifics.
Customer provided a cell number; check whether they prefer a phone follow-up.
